predecessors.name: Almoravid dynasty
predecessors.text: Córdoba and its province: the part of Cliopatria's 1147 shape (61 cells) that lies in the province of Córdoba (29 cells, 7,334 km2); the Jaén half of the shape is dropped

successors.name: Almohad Caliphate
successors.text: Córdoba and its province: the part of Cliopatria's 1147 shape (61 cells) that lies in the province of Córdoba (29 cells, 7,334 km2); the Jaén half of the shape is dropped

ledger.x: 1147: a second Taifa of Córdoba, independent of the Almoravids ('taifa de Córdoba, de 1144 a 1148, conquistada por los almohades').
1149: the taifa ends in the Almohad conquest of Córdoba; Cliopatria runs its shape to 1151.

wars.name: Almohad conquest of al-Andalus
wars.outcome: The Almohads took Córdoba in 1149 at the request of local Muslim officials; 'Muslim Spain had fallen under their control by about 1170-1172'.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier, a district list or an area; the land is Cliopatria's 1147 shape cut to the province of Córdoba.

sources.title: Alfonso VII of León and Castile
